module: Editor helper: imgui widget to edit tags and custom fields (name, value, type) of a gameplay/util/customFields object. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/customFieldsUtil')(name, fields, options). Useful to an editor tool modder who wants to display the list of tags and the table of fields, with add and remove.
usage:
local cf = require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/customFieldsUtil')('monOutil', monObjetCustomFields, {presetTags = {'a','b'}})
-- every frame, in an imgui window:
cf:widget()
notes: Options only override attributes that already exist (if self[k]): enableTags, enableFields, tagsText, fieldsText, presetTags, allowedTypes.
Default allowed types: string and number (the code also mentions boolean, vec3, quat).
If fields is nil, a new gameplay/util/customFields object is created.

C.desc: Instance of the custom fields widget.

init.desc: Initializes the widget: unique name (used in imgui identifiers), texts, enableTags/enableFields flags, presetTags list, allowed types; applies the options then setFields and refresh.

name.desc: Unique name of the instance, default "Custom Fields".

refresh.desc: Resets the input areas (name, value, tag) and the current type to "string".

setFields.desc: Sets the customFields object being edited (creates an empty one if nil).

drawCustomFields.desc: Draws the table of fields (Name, Value, Type, Remove button) and the add row with type choice and Add button.

drawTags.desc: Draws the list of tags (click: "Remove Tag" popup), the tag input, the presetTags combo and the Add Tag button.

addTag.desc: Adds the entered tag to the fields (ignored if empty) then empties the input area.

widget.desc: Draws the tags then the fields, according to enableTags and enableFields.

onActivate.desc: Callback for the edit mode; empty.

onDeactivate.desc: Callback for the edit mode; empty.
